items.title: Equivalence of regularity, normality, discrete valuation ring, invertible ideal sheaf and Cartier divisor conditions at a closed point of a curve
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the equivalence of five conditions on a closed point x of a curve over a field - regularity, normality, discrete valuation ring, invertibility of the ideal sheaf of x, and x being an effective Cartier divisor - and adds smoothness of X over k at x under a perfectness or separability hypothesis. The proof uses that the local ring at a closed point of a curve is a Noetherian local domain of dimension one, identifies conditions (4) and (5) with the maximal ideal being principal via the effective Cartier criterion, and applies the algebra characterization of discrete valuation rings to conclude the equivalence of (1) to (5) (proof lines 9375-9381). The smoothness statement is deduced from the dense smooth open lemma in the perfect case and from the separable-smoothness algebra lemma when the residue field is separable (proof lines 9382-9384). H2: the reduction to the principal-maximal-ideal criterion and the two smoothness routes are the substance.
